RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalH_softCu.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalH_softCubicPowerTrace_concentrated_base
RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalH_softCu.expanded_type:
∀ {p m n : ℕ},
  1 ≤ p →
    ∀ (ν : MeasureTheory.Measure (RectangleCLT.Vector (n + 1))) [inst : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
      (U : RectangleCLT.Face p → RectangleCLT.Vector (n + 1)) (f : Fin m → RectangleCLT.Face p)
      (a : RectangleCLT.Vector m) {C δ σ h : ℝ},
      0 ≤ C →
        0 ≤ δ →
          0 < σ →
            0 < h →
              (∀ (j : Fin m), RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq (U (f j)) = 1) →
                (∀ (b : RectangleCLT.Vector m) (s : ℝ),
                    0 < s → ν.real (RectangleCLTArxivV1.faceLayer (fun k => U (f k)) b s) ≤ C * (s + δ)) →
                  δ * √(RectangleCLT.dimensionLog p) ≤ σ →
                    ∀ (q : ℕ),
                      MeasureTheory.Integrable
                          (RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHSoftCubicPowerTrace (fun j => U (f j)) a h σ q) ν ∧
                        ∫ (x : RectangleCLT.Vector (n + 1)),
                            |RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHSoftCubicPowerTrace (fun j => U (f j)) a h σ q x| ∂ν ≤
                          32768 * Real.exp (3 / 2) * Real.exp 128 * C * h * RectangleCLT.dimensionLog p *
                            √(RectangleCLT.dimensionLog p)

RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHSoftCub.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHSoftCubicTrace_eq_binomial
RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHSoftCub.expanded_type:
∀ {m r : ℕ} (u : Fin m → RectangleCLT.Vector r) (a : RectangleCLT.Vector m) {h : ℝ},
  0 < h →
    ∀ (σ : ℝ) (K : ℕ) (x : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
      RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHSoftCubicTrace u a h σ K x =
        ∑ q ∈ Finset.range (K + 1),
          (-1) ^ q * ↑(K.choose q) * RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHSoftCubicPowerTrace u a h σ q x

RectangleCLTArxivV1.integrable_gaussianA.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.integrable_gaussianAbsoluteFace_selector_physical
RectangleCLTArxivV1.integrable_gaussianA.expanded_type:
∀ {p r K : ℕ} (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p) (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin r) ℝ) (σ : ℝ) (x : RectangleCLT.Vector r)
  (α : Fin (K + 1) → RectangleCLT.Face p),
  MeasureTheory.Integrable
    (fun g =>
      (RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq g - ↑r) *
          |RectangleCLT.faceDot (RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorFaceNormal A (α 0)) g| *

    (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r)

RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalH_cubic_.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalH_cubic_selector_nuclear_reduction_all
RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalH_cubic_.expanded_type:
∀ {p r K : ℕ} (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p) (M : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin r) ℝ) (v : RectangleCLT.Vector p)
  (α : Fin (K + 1) → RectangleCLT.Face p) (u : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
  RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq u = 1 →
    RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.symmetricNuclearNorm
        (RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHCubicSelectorScore s M v α u) ≤
      2 * RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHCubicMeanEnergy s M v α u +
            2 * RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHCubicMeanEnergy s M v α (-u) +
          RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHSelectorMass s M v α *
            (1 +
              RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq
                (RectangleCLT.Companion.weightMean (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) id fun g =>
                  RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorWeight s α (M.mulVec g + v))) -
        ∫ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
          (RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq g - ↑r) * |RectangleCLT.faceDot u g| *
            RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorWeight s α (M.mulVec g + v) ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r

                      (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun x => A.mulVec x) ν) C₀ δ κ →

passages.claim: The actual signed first-face power trace is base-integrable and its averaged absolute value is bounded by a universal C0 hκ LsqrtL independently of the power.
passages.method_variation: The proved exact Gamma coarea is combined with the actual localized hard Jf budget; the factor 1/(q+1) is bounded by one.
